summary: Verified backend chat messaging flow for AzoApp partner mobile chat. Ran 9 pytest cases against localhost:8001 (public URL also confirmed reachable). All passed: GET /api/bookings/{id}/messages returns enabled=true with me/customer/partner/messages for paid+started booking (147ad06b-...); POST as partner and as customer both return 200 with correct sender_role; thread lists both in chronological order for both parties. Gating: pending booking (62768d2c-...) returns enabled=false on GET and 400 'Chat opens after payment...' on POST. Notifications: after partner sends, customer's GET /api/notifications shows a chat_message notification (matched by event/data.type/'New message' title); vice-versa for customer→partner. Authorization: outsider phone +919000000009 gets 403 on both GET and POST.
critical_code_review_comments: send_message() at booking_controller.py:704 checks payment/status but wraps the notify+realtime emit in bare try/except: pass — silent failure of push/realtime is invisible to ops. Consider logging.exception.
send-otp on cold path takes ~11s (dev SMS). Mobile client should show a spinner and not time out < 15s.

list_messages() to_list(500) has no pagination cursor beyond the 'after' timestamp string; long-lived threads >500 msgs may silently truncate the newest — worth adding an explicit sort/limit/before cursor.
